description: Export the active part mesh, or part_id when set (an opaque surf id, never a path or display name), as STL, 3MF, or STEP bytes, or trigger a browser download.

download.description: When true, trigger a browser download instead of returning bytes.

format.description: Export encoding for the part mesh.

part_id.description: Part id; defaults to the active CAD part.

name: export_part
